0.reason: a one-caller path helper that names what it derives; inlining it changes no behaviour and is not worth a repair round on a lock migration

1.reason: the delta claim the evidence makes (no added ruff findings) holds on re-measurement; only the absolute pre-existing count is off (20 stated, 14 measured)

2.reason: log-header format only; the manifest records the revision and command of each arm

findings.text: non-blocking: _lock_path has exactly one caller, _write_entries at reckon/compliance.py:184, so the brief's condition for keeping the path derivation rather than inlining it is not met and a one-caller indirection survives the migration.

non-blocking: the record states the four modules carry 20 pre-existing ruff findings at base and the pinned ruff 0.16.4 re-measures 14 at 65431adf17 and 14 at 6cf4f73a7a, so the delta claim holds but the absolute figure in the delivered evidence does not.

non-blocking: the focused head arm's first line is "# arm: head" rather than naming the revision, tree and command on one line as the manifest contract states, so a reader keying on the first line cannot tell which revision the log ran at.

item_verdicts.diff: read both commits against 65431adf17; commit 899b8988db migrates the four sites, deletes compliance._locked in favour of a lock-path derivation, updates the review_records docstring, drops four guard rows and adds the new test file, and commit 6cf4f73a7a adds the evidence fragment, with nothing changed outside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: judged against the coordinator brief's split, which assigns four of the plan's nine section-4 locks to this node, the four pending rows are gone from tests/test_every_shared_home_lock_holds_across_nodes.py:66-79, tests/test_store_and_review_index_locks_hold_across_nodes.py holds the cross-process record-lock measurement for two of the four sites, the docstring at reckon/crew/review_records.py:1951 describes the lock taken, and the manifest records the focused gate, its base arm and the negative control.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to move the persisted-store, compliance, review-index and peer-index locks onto the cross-node lock, and reckon/_store.py:407, reckon/compliance.py:184, reckon/crew/review_records.py:1970 and reckon/crew/dispatch_peer.py:221 each now take reckon.node_exclusive_lock.exclusive_lock instead of flock.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it reports 2 passed at head and 2 failed at base for the new tests, 109 passed with 1 pre-existing failure for the 11-file focused gate, and 57 passed for the promotion suite arm, each naming its log.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's orientation_write_paths and the node prompt's fence; the seven changed paths all fall inside them, including the evidence fragment the manifest declares.

justifications.durability: reinstating the lockf take-removal in a scratch copy of reckon/node_exclusive_lock.py turns tests/test_store_and_review_index_locks_hold_across_nodes.py red with 2 failed, so the added assertions fail on the regression they guard, while the compliance and peer-index sites rest on the static guard alone.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_store_and_review_index_locks_hold_across_nodes.py is recorded green at 6cf4f73a7a in logs/head-arm.log and red at 65431adf17 in logs/negative-control-base.log, though the base focused arm at logs/base-arm.log carries two scaffolding errors and the focused head log's first line is not the revision line.
justifications.fit: the migration follows the existing property_state.py:322 use of the same helper, the review_records docstring at reckon/crew/review_records.py:1951 is updated to the lock actually taken, and no added name carries a plan or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/_store.py:407 and reckon/compliance.py:184 and reckon/crew/review_records.py:1970 and reckon/crew/dispatch_peer.py:221 all take exclusive_lock, and the answer each caller gets when the lock is unavailable is preserved by reckon/crew/review_records.py:1966-1974.
justifications.reuse: the search over reckon/ for a shared-home lock capability found reckon/node_exclusive_lock.exclusive_lock as the owner, and every migrated site calls it rather than adding a second implementation.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in git diff --stat 65431adf17..6cf4f73a7a is inside the manifest's declared orientation_write_paths, and no changed file carries work the goal does not imply.
